To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the driving force of acoustic streamings in the thermoviscoelastic medium can be presented by three terms, one of which is connected to the sound periodicity and is not zero for the non-periodic sound.
the acoustic force of streaming is the function of the sound intensity and the attenuation.
the instantaneous driving force of acoustic non-thermal streaming in the thermally and viscously relaxing fluid can be represented as a sum of three components.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the driving force of acoustic radiation streaming in a thermoviscous liquid, which is caused by the aperiodic sound field.
the driving force of acoustic microstreaming in unbounded thermoviscous media caused by aperiodically modulated sound beam.
a new approach to the acoustic streaming in the unbounded volumes caused by the aperiodic sound beams.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the driving force of the acoustic streaming is a result of the interaction of the acoustic wave with the thermoviscosity of the fluid and is proportional to the overall sound attenuation, the latter being a function of frequency.
the classic formula for acoustic force is not applicable for the non-periodic sound.
the driving force of acoustic stream is a function of the overall attenuation, and is a periodic function of the time with the same period as the acoustic wave.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the acoustic force is a complex function of the sound intensity, sound pressure, frequency and attenuation.
the non-acoustic force is the driving force of acoustic streamings caused by aperiodicity of sound beam in unbound volumes.

the acoustic force for the quasi-periodic sound is a superposition of the classic force, which is a sum of the force of the periodic sound and the additional force caused by the sound periodicity and the force caused by the periodic sound divergence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the acoustic streaming is not caused only by the classic term but also by the periodicity of sound.
the acoustic force of the Eulerian velocity is not a sum of two parts, one is a classic one and another is the periodic one.
in the unbounded volume, there is an extra driving force of acoustic stream, which is caused by aperiodicity of the sound.
